# TPC-Havoc Q11_v4

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT ps_partkey, SUM(value) AS value FROM (SELECT ps_partkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS value FROM partsupp, supplier, nation WHERE ps_suppkey = s_suppkey AND s_nationkey = n_nationkey AND n_name = 'GERMANY' AND s_suppkey % 2 = 0 GROUP BY ps_partkey UNION ALL SELECT ps_partkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS value FROM partsupp, supplier, nation WHERE ps_suppkey = s_suppkey AND s_nationkey = n_nationkey AND n_name = 'GERMANY' AND s_suppkey % 2 = 1 GROUP BY ps_partkey) AS combined GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING SUM(value) > (SELECT SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 0.0100000000 FROM partsupp, supplier, nation WHERE ps_suppkey = s_suppkey AND s_nationkey = n_nationkey AND n_name = 'GERMANY') ORDER BY value DESC
```
